rdfs:label: Site
rdfs:comment: A physical location at which an Organization operates — an office, factory, branch, or campus.
notes: Sites are *where* the Organization is, distinct from the Organization itself (which is the legal/social entity) or its OrganizationalUnits (the structural divisions). One Organization may have many Sites; one Site may host parts of several Organizations. Link a Site to its Organization with `org:siteOf` (or `org:hasSite` from the Organization side); give its address with `org:siteAddress` (range vcard:VCard).

examples.title: An office site of a company

history.note: Example uses org:siteAddress full IRI (not a registry term) and links the Site to its Organization via org:siteOf; notes mention hasSite/siteOf.
